purpose: Organizations have strict devops/security rules: only certain licenses, source domains, packages, runtime classes, or methodologies are permitted. A Teleon unit runs under an org's policy, and — critically — when the AI tooling SELF-HEALS or EVOLVES (forks) a unit, the fix it picks must stay WITHIN these confines. The policy excludes disallowed provider endpoints BEFORE objective selection (safety beats objective) and VETOES an evolution fork / self-heal candidate that violates the rules (escalate to human instead of crossing the boundary). deny_by_default + strict_unknown_license let a regulated org refuse anything it cannot positively verify. Composes with the egress route policy (architecture/egress_route_policy_taxonomy.json) for outbound-route decisions — this layer adds license/package/runtime/methodology bounds. Data only — read by src/teleon/governance; never names a src.baltor symbol.

methodology_vocabulary.deterministic_only: the runner must be fully deterministic (determinism >= 1.0) — no model/agent in the hot path
methodology_vocabulary.no_llm: the runner must make zero model calls (kind is not model/open_ended)
methodology_vocabulary.no_external_egress: the provider must run locally / on an internal domain — no public-internet egress
methodology_vocabulary.permissive_license_only: license must be on the org's allowed_licenses allowlist

default-permissive.description: baseline — no org constraints; allow everything (the default when a tenant declares no policy)

regulated-financial-strict.description: regulated bank/fintech — permissive-license allowlist, official/gov source domains only, no copyleft, no unknown licenses, local/queue runtimes only, deterministic hot path

no-copyleft.description: the common enterprise rule — no copyleft licenses; everything else permitted

deterministic-audit.description: auditable/reproducible pipeline — only deterministic, no-LLM runners may be promoted; APIs allowed

air-gapped-local-llm.description: no public-internet egress — local/self-hosted model lanes (Ollama/Gemma) allowed, cloud LLM lanes (Codex/OpenAI/Anthropic) forbidden; the AI must route inference locally
